mapper.select: SELECT res.RESOURCE_ID, res.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID, res.RESOURCE_TYPE, res.ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, res.OBJECT_KEY, res.CONTENT_TYPE, res.FILE_SIZE, res.CREATED_AT, res.UPDATED_AT, res.STATUS, res.DELETED_AT FROM TB_CONTENT_RESOURCE res JOIN TB_CONTENT_DETAIL content ON content.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID = res.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID AND content.STATUS = 'Y' AND content.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_CATEGORY category ON category.CATEGORY_ID = content.CATEGORY_ID AND category.STATUS = 'Y' AND category.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_CURRICULUM curriculum ON curriculum.CURRICULUM_ID = category.CURRICULUM_ID AND curriculum.STATUS = 'Y' AND curriculum.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE res.RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND res.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID = #{contentDetailId} AND content.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} AND curriculum.CURRICULUM_ID = #{curriculumId} AND curriculum.TEACHER_ID = #{teacherId} AND res.STATUS = 'Y' AND res.DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT res.RESOURCE_ID, res.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID, res.RESOURCE_TYPE, res.ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, res.OBJECT_KEY, res.CONTENT_TYPE, res.FILE_SIZE, res.CREATED_AT, res.UPDATED_AT, res.STATUS, res.DELETED_AT FROM TB_CONTENT_RESOURCE res JOIN TB_CONTENT_DETAIL content ON content.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID = res.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID AND content.STATUS = 'Y' AND content.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_CATEGORY category ON category.CATEGORY_ID = content.CATEGORY_ID AND category.STATUS = 'Y' AND category.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_CURRICULUM curriculum ON curriculum.CURRICULUM_ID = category.CURRICULUM_ID AND curriculum.STATUS = 'Y' AND curriculum.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_STUDENT_CURRICULUM enrollment ON enrollment.CURRICULUM_ID = curriculum.CURRICULUM_ID AND enrollment.STATUS = 'Y' AND enrollment.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION link ON link.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID = enrollment.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID AND link.STATUS = 'Y' AND link.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT relation ON relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = link.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID AND relation.STATUS = 'Y' AND relation.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND relation.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS access_row ON access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID AND access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID = #{teacherStudentAccessId} AND access_row.STATUS = 'Y' AND access_row.REVOKED_AT IS NULL WHERE res.RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND res.STATUS = 'Y' AND res.DELETED_AT IS NULL

INSERT INTO TB_CONTENT_RESOURCE ( RESOURCE_ID, CONTENT_DETAIL_ID, RESOURCE_TYPE, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, OBJECT_KEY, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{resourceId}, #{contentDetailId}, #{resourceType}, #{originalFileName}, #{objectKey}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{status,jdbcType=CHAR,typeHandler=com.yunki.lessonpt.common.mybatis.typehandler.RecordStatusTypeHandler}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CONTENT_RESOURCE SET STATUS = 'N', DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND CONTENT_DETAIL_ID = #{contentDetailId} AND STATUS = 'Y' AND DELETED_AT IS NULL

UPDATE TB_CONTENT_RESOURCE SET STATUS = 'N', DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE STATUS = 'Y' AND DELETED_AT IS NULL AND CONTENT_DETAIL_ID IN ( SELECT CONTENT_DETAIL_ID FROM TB_CONTENT_DETAIL WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} AND STATUS = 'Y' AND DELETED_AT IS NULL )
